properties.site-address: Land adjoining Norwich City Football Club (incl Groundsmans Hut and Players Car Park) & Land North Of Carrow Quay, Kerrison Road, Norwich
properties.name: N/THH/008
properties.notes: Permission for 250 flats covers part of site: land north of Carrow Quay. Remainder of site incl groundsman's hut and players car park not permissioned. Proposed allocated site in GNLP for 270 units (CC16).. Part of plan allocation for mixed use development to include a minimum of 300 dwellings including land at Carrow Quay for which outline permission has already been granted for 250. 17/01091/F: Demolition of groundman's hut and construction of 73 flats with associate parking, landscaping and highways works
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
